description: Change a trail. Change a trail's title, intent, type, priority, owner (the lead), repo scope, start and target dates, health, goal or autopilot. Pass at least one field; the rest are left as they are. Changing the type changes which release gates apply.

autopilot.description: Turn a trail's autopilot on or off, and set the limits it acts inside. Turning it ON needs the `autopilot` capability (admins have it) and a person's identity — a dashboard session or a signed-in CLI, never an ops key, an admin key or MCP — and makes that person the accountable approver. Turning it off is open to the trail's owner, whoever authorized it, and admins.

limits.description: Limits to set; each one omitted keeps the trail's current value (the project's default for a new trail).

items.description: What a trail is shipping. A `feature` trail is held to the rollback and measured release gates.

anyOf.description: A trail's goal as sent on create or update. `metric` names the metric by id or key.

baseline.description: The metric's value when the trail started, or `null`.

direction.description: Which way the metric should move.

metric.description: The metric's id or key, or `null` for a goal stated in words only.

target.description: The value the trail aims for, or `null`.

unit.description: The unit the values are in, e.g. `%` or `ms`, or `null`.

goal.description: Replaces the trail's goal; `null` clears it.

handle.description: The trail's handle (`T-12`) or its id.

anyOf.description: A trail's effective health — the one a person set, or else the derived one. Derived, first match wins: `off_track` when the target date has passed and the trail has not shipped, or a rollout is `fixing` after a pull-back; `at_risk` when the target is at most 7 days away and progress is under 75 %, or a high finding or a high or critical item on the trail is open; otherwise `on_track`. A list row carries the snapshot; the detail read recomputes it.

health.description: Set the health by hand; `null` goes back to the derived health.

ownerId.description: The `users.id` of the person owner; `null` unassigns.

anyOf.description: Triage priority of a queue item. The lowest tier is `nice_to_have` (not `low`) — carried over from the feature-request "importance" scale this priority set replaced.

startDate.description: The calendar day work starts (`YYYY-MM-DD`); `null` clears it.

targetDate.description: The calendar day the trail is meant to ship by (`YYYY-MM-DD`); `null` clears it.

type.description: What a trail is shipping. A `feature` trail is held to the rollback and measured release gates.

name: trails_update
